senses.gloss: m. (= פִּיטְפּוּט; v. בטט) puppets of clay, a set of clay (or metal) pins to put pots on for cooking, pot-stand.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 1:12">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. I, 12</cite> <he>א׳ שיש בו וכ׳</he> a pot-stand containing metal.
<cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 7:3">Tosef. Nidd. VII, 3</cite> <cite ref="A02660"><he>אפטי</he></cite> (corr. acc.).
